messages.text: Ah! You look like someone strong.

messages.raw: §fThese are trying times, indeed. The §cGraveyard §fup ahead is overflowing with monsters! Anyone who comes in is spooked off by the grunts of Zombies in the distance.
messages.text: These are trying times, indeed. The Graveyard up ahead is overflowing with monsters! Anyone who comes in is spooked off by the grunts of Zombies in the distance.
messages.zh: 真是艰难的时期。前方的墓地怪物泛滥! 每个走进酒馆的人都会被远处僵尸的低吼吓跑。

messages.context: Wiki 对白; Abiphone Contact while below Spider Slayer 9
messages.raw: §fSorry mate, not much space in the old handheld.
messages.text: Sorry mate, not much space in the old handheld.
messages.zh: 抱歉啊,我这老手机没多少地方了。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 3 September 2026, at 01:22.

messages.context: Wiki 对白; Abiphone Contact while below Spider Slayer 9
messages.raw: §fPeople always adding me left and right these days, asking if the ol' tav is open or not.
messages.text: People always adding me left and right these days, asking if the ol' tav is open or not.
messages.zh: 这些天总有人加我,问老酒馆开没开门。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 3 September 2026, at 01:22.

messages.context: Wiki 对白; Abiphone Contact while below Spider Slayer 9
messages.raw: §fI tell 'em every time that it's open every day, but when they put down the phone I know they'll call 'n ask again tomorrow.
messages.text: I tell 'em every time that it's open every day, but when they put down the phone I know they'll call 'n ask again tomorrow.
messages.zh: 我每回都说,天天都开。可他们电话一挂,我就知道明天准又要打来问。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 3 September 2026, at 01:22.

messages.context: Wiki 对白; Abiphone Contact while below Spider Slayer 9
messages.raw: §fSince I'm so limited on space, I've got to be quite particular on who I add.
messages.text: Since I'm so limited on space, I've got to be quite particular on who I add.
messages.zh: 地方实在有限,加谁可得好好挑一挑。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 3 September 2026, at 01:22.

messages.context: Wiki 对白; Abiphone Contact while below Spider Slayer 9

messages.text: You go and reach Spider Slayer 9, and I'll add you. How's that sound?
messages.zh: 你先把蜘蛛猎手升到 9 级,我就加你。怎么样?

note:
身份: 酒馆酒保,委托玩家清理墓地。
关系: 感激玩家帮忙,也谨慎挑选电话联系人。
口吻: 随和健谈,偶尔抱怨反复来电。
性格: 务实热情。
禁用风格: 不爆粗、不加现代网络梗; 保留固定猎手等级条件。
